s: LORD spread out earth (above the waters)
q: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

s: LORD made great lights
q: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

s: LORD made to rule by day sun
q: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

s: captives (exiles of Babylon) sit by rivers of Babylon (in exile)
q: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down.

s: children of Edom urged destruction of Jerusalem (on the day of Jerusalem)
q: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

s: Daughter of Babylon fate destruction (doomed)
q: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction

s: Daughter of Babylon has done harm to captives (exiles of Babylon) (to be repaid)
q: he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

s: little ones (of Babylon) belong to Daughter of Babylon
q: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

s: captives (exiles of Babylon) remember Zion (with weeping)
q: Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

s: captives (exiles of Babylon) hung up harps (on the willows)
q: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

s: captors (those who led us captive) hold captive captives (exiles of Babylon)
q: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs.

s: captors (those who led us captive) torment captives (exiles of Babylon)
q: Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy

s: songs of Zion is a songs of joy (demanded by captors)
q: Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

s: songs of Zion asks How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
q: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

s: speaker (the Psalm's speaker) prefers Jerusalem (above chief joy)
q: if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

s: speaker (the Psalm's speaker) vows to remember Jerusalem (under self-imprecation)
q: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

s: LORD exalts Name (above all)
q: for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all

s: LORD opposes enemies (stretches out his hand against their wrath)
q: You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies.

s: LORD saves David (with his right hand)
q: Your right hand will save me.

s: LORD answers David (in the day he called)
q: In the day that I called, you answered me.

s: LORD fulfills concerns of David
q: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me.

s: David gives thanks to LORD (with his whole heart)
q: I will give you thanks with my whole heart.

s: David has enemies
q: the wrath of my enemies

s: kings of the earth give thanks to LORD
q: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD

s: kings of the earth sing of LORD (his ways)
q: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD

s: LORD exalts Word (above all)
q: for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all
